- memory_id "1000715": As of 2025-10-15, the pager for the scheduler rings Team Dune instead of Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Dune, scheduler)

- memory_id "1000409": On 2025-05-19, Team Cinder noticed the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Cinder, resizer)
